description: This source file defines the DeleteThingStrategy class, which handles the DeleteThing command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages the deletion of a 'Thing' object, generates corresponding events, and manages entity tags for concurrency control.

classes.name: DeleteThingStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of a Thing within the system. It processes DeleteThing commands, logs the operation, creates a deletion event, and manages entity tags for concurrency and consistency.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the deletion of a Thing, logging the operation, creating a ThingDeleted event, and returning the result encapsulating the mutation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag from the previous state of the Thing for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional as no new entity tag is set upon deletion.
